summary: Iteration 11: Password History + Card Expiry Alerts + Password Generator regression. Backend: 91/91 pytest pass (added 5 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_password_history.py covering full flow AAA->BBB->BBB(dedup)->CCC yielding [BBB,AAA], 401 no-auth, 404 unknown, empty [], delete-cascade, and NO leak of password_history in GET /api/credentials list). Frontend (mobile viewport, PIN 1234 via keyboard): history-credential-{id} clock button opens password-history-dialog; row-0 masked '••••••••••' by default, toggle reveals 'OLD_PWD_1!' plaintext exactly, copy button clicked (toast handler wired to sonner). Empty state data-testid='password-history-empty' shown for credentials without history (verified on existing SBI/PNB seed). Password Generator: Generate button fills credential-password-input with 16-char strong password containing symbols/mixed case (verified 'eZgBL7S5rSa&%!g8'). Cards tab: banner data-testid='card-expiry-alerts' lists BOTH expired ('Expired 62 days ago' in rose) and soon ('Expires in 60 days' amber) cards, excludes far-future 12/29 card; expiry-badge-{id} shows SOON (amber) and EXPIRED (rose) respectively, 12/29 card has NO badge. Regression: Insurance tab loads with LIC premium reminders. All test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_credentials: password_history is NOT explicitly projected out at Mongo layer but response_model=List[Credential] Pydantic filter strips it since Credential model doesn't declare that field. Works, but adding `{'_id':0,'password_history':0}` at the DB projection would be more defensive (prevents accidental leaks if response_model is ever removed).

server.py update_credential dedup check: `plain_password != old_plain` correctly skips history push when password unchanged; also correctly skips when old_plain is empty (initial set). $slice=-5 caps history at last 5. Reversed order in GET endpoint yields newest-first as spec requires.
CardsTab expiryStatus uses Date.now() (client clock). If user's device clock is wrong, alerts may be inaccurate. Consider deriving from a server-provided 'now' or at least documenting. Low severity.
PasswordHistoryDialog fmtDate silently returns raw ISO on parse failure — acceptable graceful degradation.
PasswordHistoryDialog fetches history each time dialog opens (useEffect on open+credId) — correct, no stale caching.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (history dialog reveal/copy/empty, generator 16-char, expiry banner+badges soon/expired, no badge on OK card, insurance regression)
